themes.title: Populist Right Momentum Ahead of Elections
themes.blurb: Right-wing and populist movement leaders across the United States, France, and Italy are mobilizing voters through high-profile campaign rallies, national party congresses, and early voting drives. Figures such as Donald Trump, Marine Le Pen, and Matteo Salvini are using these major platform events to consolidate party unity, present platform visions, and rally their bases for upcoming elections.
